apps.subtitle: Local grid — Garmin, blocking, widgets, Live Activities.
apps.localizedDescription: Nexus Local is the on-device node of the Nexus life-OS. It runs the Garmin bridge, TimeTracker site blocking, home-screen widgets, and Live Activities, and talks to the shared Supabase backend. Installed and kept fresh through SideStore.
